# Nitin Dogra — Full Stack Developer & Next.js / Node.js Engineer

He builds production-grade software for startups, founders, and engineering teams, translating business goals into resilient, accessible digital products with sub-second page loads and zero dropped leads.

## Core Value Proposition & Quantified Outcomes

- Infraly (<https://infraly.online>): Developer-first form backend and lead CRM processing inbound form submissions with real-time email dispatch, rate-limiting, and zero spam leaks. Built with Next.js 16, Express 5, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Clerk.
- GetMeChai (<https://get-me-chai-seven.vercel.app>): Creator patron platform enabling direct fan support with one-click Razorpay payment checkout, instant webhook settlement, and responsive feeds.
- LogoCraft (<https://logocraft.nitindogra.space/>): AI vector brand identity studio featuring automated prompt synthesis, credit-based billing, and instant multi-format downloads.
- Professional Experience: Full Stack Developer Intern at Sponso Pvt Ltd (Next.js, Express, Supabase, JWT auth, REST APIs) and Navitas EduServices (Agile web application delivery).
